summary_md: Restructuring and repositioning dominate today’s batch, punctuated by an AI infrastructure buildout and defensive utility stability. **DGXX** is the clearest momentum story, executing a debt-free Alabama GPU-as-a-Service campus that is already generating early AI revenue and securing long-lead equipment. **BEEP**’s parking turnaround is gaining traction—short interest has collapsed, and a volume-led strategy is lifting utilization while asset sales deleverage the balance sheet. On the pressured side, **NTRP**’s pivot to travel media triggered a sharp post-earnings selloff, and **STRS** faces a confidence crisis as its Bitcoin-linked preferred shares slide toward all-time lows. A common thread of insider buying signals conviction across **HNRG**, **JCTC**, and **OPAL**, while tariff speculation is reshaping demand narratives in textiles (**CULP**, **UFI**). Regulated utilities **RGCO** and **UTL** offer defensive ballast, with rate relief and steady dividends attracting institutional interest.
